mechanism_narrative: Persistent deterioration in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES means fewer commuting and errand journeys; because retail-and-recreation footfall is carried by the same trip chains, RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next 28 days relative to the last 28.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -13.9 to -18.6 and WORKPLACES from -22.1 to -30.9 in the final week
regime_hint: steady state with weakening trip demand
failure_condition: If the forward 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is at or above the trailing 28-day mean (-16.5) while TRANSIT stays below -10 and WORKPLACES below -20, the trip-chain channel is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the weekly GROCERY_PHARM mean crosses below +2.0 percent of baseline, routine errand demand has contracted; the drop from +7.4 to +0.4 at t-0w marks that crossing, and reduced errand frequency drags RETAIL_REC lower over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean crosses below +2.0 (observed +7.4 at t-1w to +0.4 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell 7.0 points in the final week to +0.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains below +2.0 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high PARKS (+23.4) and above-baseline RESIDENTIAL (+3.0) show leisure time being spent outdoors near home rather than in commercial venues, so discretionary indoor retail-and-recreation spend falls over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS above +20 and RESIDENTIAL above +2.5 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped to +23.4 while RESIDENTIAL rose to +3.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while PARKS stays above +20 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +2.5.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week collapse of WORKPLACES of more than 8 points (-22.1 to -30.9) signals renewed workplace-occupancy restrictions or voluntary withdrawal; the resulting loss of weekday footfall lowers RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
failure_condition: Forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above the trailing mean while WORKPLACES stays below -28 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-October fair-weather days lift PARKS to +23.4; the same dry, mild conditions raise street-level pedestrian counts, so RETAIL_REC recovers modestly over the next two weeks even without any change in restrictions.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS reached +23.4, the highest of the four observed weeks
regime_hint: autumn steady state with no restrictions
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 14 days while PARKS remains above +15.

mechanism_narrative: The single-week fall in GROCERY_PHARM from +7.4 to +0.4 means household restocking has ended; the released time and budget are redirected to discretionary retail, lifting RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM week-on-week drop greater than 5 points
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM dropped 7.0 points between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the next 7 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains below +2.0.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -15 while GROCERY_PHARM falls below +2.0 in the same week, work-trip and errand-trip channels contract together; the compounded loss of trip-chaining cuts RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -15 and GROCERY_PHARM below +2.0 in the same week (observed at t-0w: -18.6 and +0.4)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT -18.6 and GROCERY_PHARM +0.4 co-occurred at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 7 days under the same joint TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a pre-restriction regime where RESIDENTIAL exceeds +2.5 and WORKPLACES falls below -28, households shift time homeward ahead of announced measures, depressing retail-and-recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above +2.5 and WORKPLACES below -28 in the same week (observed at t-0w: +3.0 and -30.9)
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL +3.0 and WORKPLACES -30.9 co-occurred at t-0w
failure_condition: Forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the trailing mean while the joint RESIDENTIAL above +2.5 and WORKPLACES below -28 condition persists.
